integrity: Two complete standard-library Python checkers and a stand-alone mathematical proof are embedded with exact content hashes.
scientific_limitations: Five-dimensional binary vertex-metric resolving sets only, arbitrary one-for-one landmark replacements. Existing ternary-kernel and antipode lemmas are prior art. A plausible 2013 hypercube article and a contemporary metric-basis reconfiguration thesis were not available in complete text; equivalent historical classification remains a residual risk. Computations corroborate a self-contained proof, not an independent external audit.
title: Sixteen rigid root classes of minimum resolving bases in the five-cube
